caption: The drawing depicts two objects on a plain, light-colored background: the first object, on the left side, is a handle or stick designed with a beige woven pattern, topped with a silver-tone metallic cap and ending with a rounded woven knot at the opposite end; the second object, on the right side, appears to be a partially open parasol or umbrella with a handle and a canopy made of a blue-green fabric overlaid with intricate white lace in a geometric grid and floral pattern, featuring additional lace trim along the edges and a hanging decorative tassel attached near the center. The blue-green color of the parasol canopy contrasts with the beige and white tones of the handle and lacework, and the objects are carefully detailed and positioned so that the parasol is shown at an angle, with its handle extending to the left.
title: Parasol
